causal_chain: A disagreement-aware routing gate can detect when direct user-item affinity and prototype-mediated affinity diverge, then selectively trust prototype transport for ambiguous or mixed-interest cases.

An anti-collapse auxiliary objective that discourages all mass concentrating on one prototype keeps the multi-prototype representation functionally active rather than degenerating into standard matrix factorization.
Representing each item as a mixture over shared collaborative prototypes lets the scorer compare users and items at the facet level rather than only through one global dot product.
Representing each user as a sparse mixture over several latent preference prototypes preserves separable intent components instead of averaging them away.
Together these changes should recover hard positives whose relevance is tied to one user facet, improving full-sort NDCG@10 under pairwise training.
Users in ML-1M often express multiple stable but partially conflicting taste facets that a single embedding compresses together.
blind_projection.closest_parent: A recommender that represents each user and item as adaptive mixtures over multiple latent prototypes, then scores a pair through disagreement-aware prototype routing and a residual anti-collapse pairwise objective, will improve full-sort NDCG@10 by capturing multi-intent user preference and context-free item facet diversity that single-embedding pairwise matrix-factorization-style mechanisms cannot express.
blind_projection.competing_explanation: Any gain could come from increased parameter count or regularization effects rather than from prototype routing itself; a matched single-prototype control with comparable parameter budget would then erase the advantage.
discriminative_predictions: Compared with a matched single-prototype control, the multi-prototype routed model should show larger ranking gains for users with longer and more diverse train histories than for users with very short homogeneous histories.

If disagreement-aware routing is causally useful, routing activations should be higher on evaluation cases where direct affinity and prototype-mediated affinity disagree, and ablating the gate should hurt NDCG@10 more than removing only the anti-collapse term.

If the benefit is true facet decomposition rather than mere capacity, prototype usage entropy should remain meaningfully above collapse while the mechanism-off variant concentrates mass on one prototype and loses tail or substitute-item recoveries.
expected_evidence: Ablation to the mechanism-off definition removes the routed facet interaction and reduces ranking quality on mixed-interest users.
Against the matched control, the full mechanism yields distinct prototype usage patterns across users instead of near-uniform collapse or single-prototype domination.
Qualification runs show the full mechanism is executable as a candidate-local RecBole GeneralRecommender under pairwise training and full-sort evaluation.
blind_projection.falsifier: If a matched single-prototype version with comparable parameter count matches or exceeds the proposed model, or if learned prototype assignments collapse so that effective behavior is indistinguishable from one embedding per user and item, the hypothesis is falsified.
blind_projection.high_change_justification: This is a non-nested shift from static single-vector collaborative scoring to a mixture-of-prototypes recommender with explicit facet routing and an auxiliary anti-collapse training signal. The proposal changes the representational unit, the scoring interaction, and the objective structure rather than adjusting a sampler or regularizer within an existing MF or LightGCN family.
blind_projection.hypothesis: A candidate-local GeneralRecommender that learns K shared collaborative prototypes, encodes each user and item as adaptive mixtures over those prototypes, and scores each pair through a disagreement-aware gate that fuses direct affinity with prototype-mediated affinity will outperform single-embedding pairwise collaborative filters on ML-1M full-sort NDCG@10 because it preserves multi-intent user structure and item facet diversity during ranking.
implementation_requirements: Add a disagreement-aware fusion gate driven by the difference between direct and prototype-mediated evidence to combine the two scores.
Compute item mixture weights from item embeddings via a separate projection and softmax.
Compute user mixture weights from the train-only aggregated history embedding of each user via a small gating MLP or linear projection and softmax.
Form a direct affinity score from base user and item embeddings.
Form a prototype-mediated score from user prototype mixture against item prototype mixture, using shared latent space dot products.
Implement a new RecBole GeneralRecommender with train-time pairwise loss and full-sort predict support.
Include an anti-collapse auxiliary term that encourages non-degenerate prototype utilization across a minibatch without using held-out information.
Keep all histories, prototype assignments, and statistics derived strictly from the training split.
Maintain base user and item embeddings plus shared prototype matrices for users and items.
Provide full-sort scoring by caching user mixtures and item mixtures from train-fitted parameters only.
blind_projection.matched_control_requirement: Use a candidate-local matched control that preserves the same train-only history aggregation path, optimizer family, loss form, and approximate parameter budget, but disables prototype mixtures by setting one effective prototype and removes disagreement-aware fusion so scoring reduces to a single direct channel.
blind_projection.mechanism_change: Replace single-vector user/item representations with adaptive mixtures over shared latent prototypes and replace single-channel scoring with a disagreement-aware fusion of direct affinity and prototype-mediated affinity, trained with pairwise ranking plus anti-collapse regularization.
blind_projection.mechanism_off_definition: Mechanism-off is a matched single-prototype descendant: user history is still aggregated, but user and item mixture modules are constrained to one effective prototype, the disagreement-aware fusion gate is fixed to trust only direct affinity, and the anti-collapse term is removed. This preserves training protocol and similar capacity plumbing while deleting the proposed facet-routing mechanism.
blind_projection.minimal_testable_wedge: Implement a 4-prototype user/item mixture recommender with soft assignment, direct-plus-prototype fused scoring, and one anti-collapse minibatch penalty, then compare it to the matched single-prototype mechanism-off variant under identical frozen ML-1M protocol settings.
blind_projection.research_question: Under the frozen ML-1M pairwise full-sort protocol, does explicit multi-prototype user/item representation with disagreement-aware routing improve ranking beyond a matched single-prototype collaborative filter, especially for mixed-interest users?
blind_projection.resource_hypothesis: The model is lightweight enough for the qualification budget because it adds only small prototype tables and gating projections on top of embedding-based scoring; no sequence transformer, graph propagation, or expensive per-batch search is required.
